description: Create a new UTF-8 text file. The operation fails if the file already exists. Paths are workspace-relative unless the user explicitly enabled unrestricted host access.

propertyDescriptions.path: Workspace-relative file path, or an absolute host path only in unrestricted mode.
propertyDescriptions.content: The complete UTF-8 text to write to the new file.
propertyDescriptions.encoding: The text encoding to use for the new file.

guidance: create_file creates a new file and must not overwrite an existing file. It accepts an absolute host path only during explicitly confirmed Dangerous full access.
